title: Preparation process of mesophase pitch-based carbon fiber: a review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39514-39538
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05325K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mingzhi Wang, Saif Ullah, Muhammad Rizwan, Xiaolong Zhou
This paper provides a comparative evaluation of the advantages and disadvantages of each process step for the preparation of pitch-based carbon fibers, discusses strategies for process optimization, highlights critical operational considerations, and examines improvements in experimental equipment.
